summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests 2X-121 as a single medicine for recurrent, advanced ovarian cancer that is platinum-resistant or in patients who are not eligible for platinum. 2X-121 is taken by mouth as capsules once daily in 28-day cycles, with 600 mg daily compared to 800 mg daily; total study length is not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; the study aims to select the best dose using PK/PD, safety, and efficacy data.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa 2X-121 como medicamento único para el cáncer de ovario recurrente y avanzado que es resistente al platino o en pacientes que no son elegibles para platino. 2X-121 se toma por vía oral en cápsulas una vez al día en ciclos de 28 días, comparando 600 mg diarios con 800 mg diarios; la duración total del estudio no se indica. La medida de resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio busca elegir la mejor dosis con base en datos de farmacocinética/farmacodinámica, seguridad y eficacia.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with recurrent, advanced epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer.
High-grade serous or endometrioid, or predominantly serous or endometrioid tumor histology.
Platinum-resistant disease (progression within 6 months after last platinum dose), or platinum ineligible.
No more than one prior line of therapy in the platinum-resistant or platinum-ineligible setting.
Measurable disease on CT or MRI, and ECOG performance status of 1 or less.
not_for: Platinum-refractory disease, meaning progression during the last platinum-based chemotherapy.
Concurrent chemotherapy, radiotherapy, hormonal therapy, or other investigational drug during the study.
Another malignancy, except stage I or II cancer judged cured by the investigator.
Active hepatitis B or C, known HIV positivity, or active infection needing antibiotics.
Stroke, TIA, or heart attack within 12 months, or clinically significant heart disease.
